# @aponiajs/serve-static

> Nest-compatible `ServeStaticModule` for AponiaJS, serving static directories and SPA fallback routes across Elysia, Hono, and H3 via `RequestLifecycleHook`.

## Key exports

- `ServeStaticModule.forRoot(options)`
- `ServeStaticModule.forRootAsync(options)`
- `ServeStaticModuleOptions`
- `ServeStaticModuleAsyncOptions`
